question: Among cards illustrated by artists who have worked on Phyrexian-language cards, count how many have unknown power (NULL or '*') and are either textless or have a normal layout. Exclude cards that are only available in foil (i.e., require hasFoil = 0).

arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c."XCL_002" IN (
    SELECT c2."XCL_002"
    FROM cards AS c2
    INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c2."XCL_072" = fd."XCL_082"
    WHERE fd."XCL_077" = 'Phyrexian'
)
AND (c."XCL_055" IS NULL OR c."XCL_055" = '*')
AND (c."XCL_022" = 1 OR c."XCL_037" = 'normal')
AND c."XCL_021" = 0
